title: L1 Tokens Crushed in 2025 as SOL, AVAX Drop Over 65%: Report
summary: Layer 1 blockchain tokens experienced severe depreciation in 2025, with Solana falling 35.9% and Avalanche dropping over 67%, as markets punished protocols lacking credible revenue streams despite robust developer activity across major ecosystems. title: Pope Leo Surprises St. Peter’s Crowd Before Christmas Eve Mass
summary: Pope Leo XIV greeted the soggy faithful in St. Peter’s Square in both English and Italian and apologized that there wasn’t enough room in the basilica for them all.
